title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CPU
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CPU. Computational processing unit of virtual and physical machines. Subclass of Device per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Device model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CPU'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

cpuArchitecture.description: Property. Architecture of CPU as defined per QEMU x86 definitions; non-listed architectures designated as 'other'. Controlled-vocabulary value (Architectures), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

cpuFlag.description: Property. CPU flags as documented by lscpu per Linux kernel definitions; unlisted flags marked as 'other'.

smtEnabled.description: Property. Whether simultaneous multithreading (SMT) or hyper-threading (HT) is active. Defaults to false.

numberOfCores.description: Property. Number of cores of the CPU.

numberOfThreads.description: Property. Number of threads of the CPU.

baseFrequency.description: Relationship. Base frequency of the CPU. Links to a Frequency entity.

boostFrequency.description: Relationship. Boost frequency of the CPU. Links to a Frequency entity.

lastLevelCacheSize.description: Relationship. Last Level Cache size of the CPU. Links to a MemorySize entity.

thermalDesignPower.description: Relationship. CPU Thermal Design Power. Links to a Power entity.
